title: Assume Formlessness
coreMove: Change outward form when fixed patterns become easy to predict and contain
sourcePressure: Chapter 48 centers on adaptability and the refusal to stay trapped in one fixed shape. The law argues that rigid form can be predicted, targeted, and broken, while formlessness preserves freedom to respond to changing conditions. Its practical claim is narrower than shapeless chaos: flexibility protects power when it stays purposeful rather than drifting into incoherence. Frozen sidecar provides no traceable named anecdote for this chapter; do not fabricate named source anchors.
